title: SvgEllipse
responsibility: Renders the native ellipse element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgEllipse.attributes
inputs.description: Native ellipse attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgEllipse.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native ellipse element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgEllipse
outputs.description: The actual native ellipse element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
